h: Obasanjo's son names his preferred 2027 presidential candidate
p: Olujuwon Obasanjo, son of former President Olusegun Obasanjo, has declared whom he prefers among Tinubu, Obi and Makinde for 2027. The comment adds to the debate over a southern candidate.
more: His father has been openly critical of the Tinubu government.
Supporters of each camp have reacted online.
